response.overview: Aural Float – Moving Images is a 2007 DVD-Video (PAL, Germany), released on Elektrolux, distributed by WVG Medien GmbH, Made in the E.E.C, label code LC 01175, barcode 4260016330171.  Moving Images includes selected Aural Float tracks along with comprehensive bonus material, with the tracks reinterpreted by well-known video artists using high-quality film material. It was produced and published in cooperation with Corbis Motion, one of the most respected image and film agencies for digital media. The cover image is taken from the video for "Kindergarten (Life In Dub)," with artwork by Markus Kreiss.
response.title: Aural Float: Moving Images
